subject: LogicWave scoped retention evidence and rollback plan
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@logicwave.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: secops@logicwave.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: scoped retention evidence + rollback plan for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week. Our security team asked for two things before we move to procurement: a concise evidence package that maps Redwood's log retention controls to the SIG/CAIQ questions (particularly around customer-scoped ephemeral debug logs), and a documented rollback/undo plan showing how to remove a short-term retention exception for a single tenant if requested by their legal team.

Specifically we need:
- A mapping table showing where Redwood's controls satisfy SIG/CAIQ items (focus on logging & erasure).
- Example proof artifacts (anonymized log export showing deletion markers, a sample retention matrix).
- A short runbook for reversing a tenant-specific 90->180 day retention carveout (audit trail + proof-of-delete).

Can you provide these in a single package (PDF + sample CSV) by next Monday? Our procurement is on a tight schedule.

Appreciate it — Lina
Lina Gomez
Head of InfoSec, LogicWave Systems
lina.gomez@logicwave.com

--
Attachment: requested_scope_template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@logicwave.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: scoped retention evidence + rollback plan for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear list. Yep, we can deliver that. High-level plan below and a couple of clarifying Qs so we scope artifacts correctly:

What we'll deliver (target: Monday 11/30):
- SIG/CAIQ mapping document (annotated PDF) that highlights where our data lifecycle controls map to questions in the logging/erasure sections.
- Evidence bundle: (1) anonymized export showing retention tombstones and proof-of-delete event, (2) retention matrix CSV with tenant-level TTLs, (3) sample audit log for a rollback operation.
- Rollback runbook: step-by-step for revoking a tenant carveout + verification checklist.

Quick clarifications:
1) For the rollback runbook — do you want the low-level CLI/API commands we run for private on-prem customers, or the hosted flow (console + support ticket + automated erase)?
2) For anonymized exports, do you require redaction of derived embeddings/LLM prompts, or is token-level masking sufficient?

I'll loop in Priya (evidence) and Marissa (customer ops) and we'll assemble the package. If you prefer a short call to finalize scope, I can book 30 mins today.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

--
Attachment: none

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: lina.gomez@logicwave.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: scoped retention evidence + rollback plan for SIG/CAIQ

Ben / Marissa — putting together the bundle now. Notes on artifacts and constraints: 

Artifacts I'll include:
- sig-evidence-pack-v2.pdf: mapping table + inc. control references (SOC2 control ids where applicable).
- redwood_log-retention-matrix.csv: tenant_id (anonymized), retention_ttl_days, retention_reason, proof_delete_event_id.
- playbook-rollback-export-steps.md: host/hosted variants (console + API), expected timelines, verification queries, and required ticket fields for Support escalate.

Constraints / wording to set expectations with LogicWave:
- For hosted customers we can execute a tenant TTL change and full re-export / selective erase; proof-of-delete is a deletion event in our immutable audit stream plus a sanitized export of the affected keys. We cannot provide raw PII in artifacts — everything will be pseudonymized.
- On-prem/private installs: we will provide the runbook and can assist, but customer is responsible for executing on their infra unless under a Professional Services engagement.

I'll regenerate the proof-of-delete example with masked tokens and include a one-page summary explaining the audit trail and retention tombstones. Target deliverable: 2026-11-30 EOD.

Priya Natarajan
Compliance & Evidence Lead | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

--
Attachments: sig-evidence-pack-v2.pdf, redwood_log-retention-matrix.csv, playbook-rollback-export-steps.md

From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@logicwave.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: secops@logicwave.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: scoped retention evidence + rollback plan for SIG/CAIQ

Ben / Priya — this looks great, thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of follow-ups after a quick review of the attachments you sent: 

- The anonymized proof-of-delete sample meets our needs. Token masking is fine.
- For the rollback runbook, we prefer the hosted flow (console + support ticket + automated erase) but please include the CLI/API appendix for our engineering team.
- Please add one sentence in the runbook about notification windows for customers (we need to capture our policy team language for communication).

If you can add that small note and send a final PDF, procurement is ready to draft the SOW. We'll loop in our procurement lead and start the DocuSign process next week.

Thanks again — Lina

--
Attachment: proc_next_steps.txt
